scientific_question: In the FireFlow room flow field, which is the strongest contiguous high-speed flow region? Define high-speed locations as those at or above the linearly interpolated 90th percentile of non-zero speed values, where speed is the Euclidean magnitude of the stored uvw vector at each point, group locations that share an unstructured-mesh cell into contiguous regions, and use peak speed as region strength. Report the strongest region’s mean spatial location across its retained high-speed locations and its peak speed.
